segments.text: Good morning, my name is Niko Avelo and welcome back to Acme Tips.
segments.zh: 早上好，我是 Niko Avelo，欢迎回到 EquiTips。

segments.text: Today we're joined by Ethan Houston with Finco.
segments.zh: 今天和我们一起的是 FinnCo 的 Ethan Houston。

segments.text: Pleasure to meet you.
segments.zh: 很高兴认识你。

segments.text: Pleasure to meet you Ethan, thank you for joining us.
segments.zh: 很高兴认识你，Ethan，谢谢你来参加。

segments.text: Yes sir.
segments.zh: 不客气。

segments.text: Can you tell us a little bit about Finco Ethan?
segments.zh: Ethan，能给我们讲讲 FinnCo 吗？

segments.text: Finco is one of the leading manufacturers in ambient vaporizers.
segments.zh: FinnCo 是空温式汽化器的领先制造商之一。

segments.text: We offer about 20 different models,
segments.zh: 我们提供大约 20 种不同的型号，

segments.text: have a very skilled engineering department,
segments.zh: 拥有一支技术非常精湛的工程部门，

segments.text: who can customize any unit to fit your needs.
segments.zh: 可以根据你的需求定制任何设备。

segments.text: Sounds like a great product and a great company.
segments.zh: 听起来是个很棒的产品，也是一家很棒的公司。

segments.text: Yes sir.
segments.zh: 是的。

segments.text: Now tell me, where would I find these?
segments.zh: 那么请告诉我，在哪里能看到这些设备？

segments.text: What are they different applications?
segments.zh: 它们有哪些不同的应用？

segments.text: You would see these from hospitals to filling soap pots, anything like that.
segments.zh: 从医院到充装站，这类地方都能看到它们。

segments.text: We have nitrogen service, also oxygen service.
segments.zh: 我们有用于氮气的，也有用于氧气的。

segments.text: Sounds like a great product.
segments.zh: 听起来是个很棒的产品。

segments.text: If I wanted to buy this amazing product,
segments.zh: 如果我想买这款很棒的产品，

segments.text: where can I buy it?
segments.zh: 在哪里能买到？

segments.text: Reach out the echo gas.
segments.zh: 联系 EquiGas 就行。

segments.text: Turn it here folks.
segments.zh: 各位，就是这些了。

segments.text: Thank you Ethan.
segments.zh: 谢谢你，Ethan。

segments.text: Yes sir.
segments.zh: 不客气。
